scope: Synthetic Chromium UI with OPFS and simulated picker/GitHub/reload. Does not verify OS directory picker or extension runtime.
checks: Migration removes old credential and private-source cache before an immediate anonymous check
Automatic check reuses the authorized installation and sends no patient data
Failed automatic check does not open a dialog or block registration
Update dialog shows first-run setup and current version
Same-version copied directory is rejected by installed-folder proof
Folder handle is saved after proof succeeds
Missing public release explains retry without requesting credentials
New version and release notes appear with one-click update
Seeing a new version manually suppresses repeated automatic prompts during the same opening
Offline check leaves tool available and displays retry message
Corrupted download leaves source untouched and unlocks registration
Multiple tool windows block reload and file replacement
Successful update reloads once, retains folder authorization and preserves application data exactly
Reopening checks again even with a successful check saved moments earlier
Update UI fits compact desktop
A successful up-to-date check leaves the dialog closed
Opening the tool automatically presents a freshly detected update without modifying records or installing
Closing the reminder keeps registration available and suppresses repeated periodic prompts
Cached update information does not trigger a popup when the fresh check fails
An update found during a query waits until the query finishes
An update found during record editing does not cover the existing dialog
The pending reminder also waits for field editing and opens after focus leaves the field
No browser runtime errors
